title.narrative: EU Trade and Competitiveness Programme for Morocco, Tunisia, Egypt and Jordan - EIB componen

description.narrative: The main objectives of the Project are to facilitate access to finance for SMEs in the form of the Risk Sharing Facility through Financial Intermediaries (FI) to reach out to underserved companies with a focus on improving selected value chains; build capacity of FI, Final Recipients, and local authorities to support the implementation of the Project; improve competitiveness of selected sectors and prospects for trade. The Project will enable SMEs to benefit from trade openness with the Union.
